_about: Chloroform (1) + Methyl isobutyl ketone (2): isothermal total pressures at 303.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of chloroform, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.
